Subject: Quickstart + next steps — Hosted API evaluation (BrightLeaf)

Hi Emily,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the demo time. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can get you evaluating Hosted API ASAP: 

Recap:
- Goal: integrate LLM-based call summarization and embeddings into BrightLeaf’s analyst dashboard for Q2 POC.
- Key constraints: low latency on single-request generative responses, embeddings at scale for nightly batch jobs, and a short evaluation window (2–3 weeks).

Hosted API as a fit for evaluation:
- Fastest path: no infra changes, immediate API keys, and sandbox usage.
- Limits: hosted tiers have default rate limits (we can temporarily increase for sandbox).

Proposed next steps:
1) Quickstart: I attached a short quickstart guide (redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf) and a sample schema (brightleaf-eval-sample-schema.json).
2) Sandbox creds & endpoints: I can spin up a temporary sandbox tenant with elevated rate limits for 2 weeks.
3) Tech sync: 30-min kickoff with Marissa (solutions eng) to validate sample prompts, embedding sizes, and test dataset upload.

Technical notes (Hosted API sandbox defaults):
- Region endpoint: https://api.us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1
- Auth: API key in Authorization header (Bearer).
- Default rate limits: 100 requests/min per API key; for sandbox we can enable up to 100 req/s burstable to 200 for short windows.
- Billing: per-token usage; embeddings billed per vector.

Can you confirm: (a) a good day/time for the 30-min kickoff next week, and (b) whether you want us to enable embeddings and generative routes in the sandbox up front?

Thanks — cc’ing Marissa to schedule the technical kickoff.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

1) Data residency: our legal team prefers US-only processing for this POC. Does the hosted sandbox guarantee US-only processing?
2) Rate limits: we have a peak of ~100 concurrent embedding calls during nightly batch windows (about 45 minutes). Will the sandbox handle that, or should we look at Dedicated capacity for the test?

If Hosted can be configured for US-only processing and you can support the embedding peak during the test window, Hosted would be easiest for us to start. Otherwise, we may need to evaluate Dedicated.

Emily — thanks for the questions, good ones. Answers inline below and next-step suggestions.

1) Data residency: yes — our Hosted sandbox can be pinned to US regions only (we run the tenant in our us-west-2 region and will disable cross-region failover for the evaluation). For production, we offer Dedicated and Private VPC options if you require additional controls.

2) Rate limits / embedding throughput:
- Hosted sandbox: we can temporarily allocate a higher throughput policy for your tenant to handle ~100 concurrent embedding requests during the nightly window. Practically we’ve done this by bumping per-key rate limits and enabling additional burst capacity for the two-week POC.
- If you need guaranteed sustained throughput at high concurrency beyond the POC, Dedicated reserved capacity is the right long-term approach (predictable GPU pool and throughput).

3) Security questionnaire: please send the questionnaire to security@redwood.ai — I’ve cc’d Marissa who will own the technical security responses and can loop in our security team for SOC2 evidence and data-retention specifics.

Quickstart/endpoint details (example cURL):
curl -X POST https://api.us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD-SANDBOX-PLACEHOLDER" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.3", "input":"Summarize the following call notes..." }'

Notes on rate limits and tokens:
- We charge per token generated + per-token input for embeddings.
- Sandbox billing will be waived for the POC within agreed limits; we’ll share a usage cap to avoid surprises.

Proposed schedule:
- Technical kickoff (30m): Wed 2027-02-10 or Thu 2027-02-11, 10–11am PT. Marissa will lead the session and validate sample prompts, embedding vector sizes, and upload flow.
- I’ll provision the sandbox tenant after you confirm the date and reply with a small sample CSV (or S3 link) for the nightly embedding test.

Cc’ing Marissa to confirm availability and to pick up security questionnaire routing.

Best,
Aditya
